scaleControls.description: Assumed 1.16m overall panel width; relative layout only, no claim of measured interior scale.

overlays.scope: Nearly frontal cockpit photo, with perspective uncorrected; flat panel positions and contour compared. Callout labels are ignored.

corrections: Own D3 airframe from dimensioned projections, five main rotor blades, ten visible Fenestron blades and true through-duct, twin engine cowling, low skids and rear clamshell seams.
Helionix three-screen and standby layout traced from Airbus frontal cockpit photograph; engine controls, paired lower screens, console, overhead and eight individual seats.
Overlay iterations extended the forward glazing, adjusted stabilizer height and parked blade angle, corrected pedestal interference and its attachment, and fixed one-sided tail fan blades.
limitations: Cabin and engine-fairing compound curves are deliberately faceted; the drawing projections differ slightly in vertical proportions. Printed dimensions govern.

Panel width of 1.16m is an explicit estimate: the nearly frontal source photo supplies relative positions, not a measured cockpit installation. Perspective, coaming depth and seat dimensions remain approximate.
Manufacturer photo shows more equipment detail than the simplified original display graphics and modeled overhead switches. Optional mission fittings and liveries vary.
Reference pictures remain local research material; no source pixels are distributed.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
